topic.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning and Off-Policy Representation
topic.overview: Offline reinforcement learning seeks useful policies from previously collected trajectories rather than unrestricted new interaction. The represented methods address policy optimization, value estimation, learned dynamics, and representations that make historical experience more useful. Dataset coverage and behavior quality shape which decisions the data can support.
topic.whyItMatters: A policy can exploit inaccurate value estimates in regions absent from the dataset. Reliable learning must distinguish genuine improvement from optimistic extrapolation, especially when combining experience from different sources or augmenting limited trajectories.
topic.evolution: The historical span includes off-policy evaluation and later option learning. Around 2020–2022, representatives emphasize model-based offline optimization, stationary-distribution correction, and unsupervised pretraining. Recent work adds cross-domain value alignment and task-structured trajectory augmentation. The collection reflects several complementary ways to extract more value from fixed experience, each with its own coverage assumptions.
openQuestions: When does synthetic trajectory augmentation improve coverage without reinforcing model error?
Which representation objectives transfer across changes in reward or logging policy?

papers.title: Option-aware Temporally Abstracted Value for Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: OTA incorporates options into value learning to shorten the effective horizon and improve the signals used to learn high-level subgoals.

papers.title: Pretraining a Shared Q-Network for Data-Efficient Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Pretraining a shared Q-network backbone on transition prediction improves offline reinforcement learning performance and data efficiency.

papers.title: Rebalancing Return Coverage for Conditional Sequence Modeling in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: RVDT improves offline sequence-based reinforcement learning by rebalancing coverage of both expert-level returns and the broader return spectrum.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Action Chunking
papers.tldr: Q-chunking learns over action sequences to improve exploration and sample efficiency in offline-to-online reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Robust Policy Expansion for Offline-to-Online RL under Diverse Data Corruption
papers.tldr: RPEX uses inverse probability weighting to reduce corruption-induced heavy-tailed policy behavior and improve offline-to-online reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Tabular Self-Play for Offline Robust Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: RTZ-VI-LCB learns robust strategies from offline game data with near-optimal sample complexity and optimal state–action scaling.

papers.title: Scaling Offline RL via Efficient and Expressive Shortcut Models
papers.tldr: SORL uses shortcut generative policies and Q-function verification to support efficient offline learning and beneficial test-time compute scaling.

papers.title: Structural Information-based Hierarchical Diffusion for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: SIHD adapts diffusion planning hierarchies to trajectory structure and uses structural guidance to improve offline decisions in long-horizon, sparse-reward settings.

papers.title: Trajectory Balance with Asynchrony: Decoupling Exploration and Learning for Fast, Scalable LLM Post-Training
papers.tldr: TBA uses off-policy trajectory balance to learn efficiently from asynchronously generated experience, reporting speedups of four times or more.

papers.title: Uni-RL: Unifying Online and Offline RL via Implicit Value Regularization
papers.tldr: Uni-RL uses reference-policy-based value regularization and policy extraction to unify online, offline, and offline-to-online reinforcement learning.

papers.title: Value-Guided Decision Transformer: A Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Online and Offline Settings
papers.tldr: VDT integrates value-based guidance into Decision Transformers to support offline training, efficient online improvement, and return-informed sampling.

papers.title: AC-ODM: Actor–Critic Online Data Mixing for Sample-Efficient LLM Pretraining
papers.tldr: AC-ODM learns to adjust pretraining data mixtures, improving reported training efficiency and downstream performance with small computational overhead.

papers.title: Causal Flow Q-Learning for Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: A causal worst-case objective improves flow-matching policies learned from demonstrations with hidden sensory confounding.

papers.title: Doubly Robust Distributionally Robust Offline Contextual Pricing
papers.tldr: A doubly robust framework improves evaluation and learning of continuous pricing policies under distribution shift, with conditional efficiency and regret guarantees.

papers.title: DRIFT: Decoupled Rollouts and Importance-Weighted Fine-Tuning for Efficient Multi-Turn Optimization
papers.tldr: DRIFT trains on return-weighted offline interaction trajectories to achieve competitive multi-turn behavior with supervised-fine-tuning efficiency.

papers.title: Efficient and Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Framework for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: DUAL combines distilled diffusion policies with uncertainty and distribution-shift detection to improve offline-to-online reinforcement-learning returns.

papers.title: From Reward-Free Representations to Preferences: Rethinking Offline Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Learning representations from reward-free offline data before preference-based adaptation improves the reported efficiency of human feedback.

papers.title: From Static Constraints to Dynamic Adaptation: Sample-Level Constraint Relaxation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: DARE relaxes reinforcement-learning constraints using each sample’s behavioral alignment, improving offline-to-online fine-tuning in reported experiments.

papers.title: Improving Zero-Shot Offline RL via Behavioral Task Sampling
papers.tldr: Extracting training tasks from offline behavior instead of sampling them randomly improves zero-shot reinforcement-learning performance by 20% on average in the reported evaluations.

papers.title: InfraRL: A Benchmark for Constrained Resource Allocation in Large-Scale Infrastructure Asset Management
papers.tldr: InfraRL benchmarks offline bridge-maintenance decisions under hard budgets, exposing trade-offs between structural utility, constraint adherence, and long-term efficiency.

papers.title: Long-Horizon Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning Without Explicit Conservatism
papers.tldr: NEUBAY combines Bayesian world-model uncertainty with long rollouts to achieve competitive offline RL without explicit conservatism.

papers.title: Offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Sequential Score Decomposition
papers.tldr: OMSD uses conditional diffusion-based regularization to keep offline agents’ actions coordinated within valuable behavior modes represented in the data.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning of High-Quality Behaviors Under Robust Style Alignment
papers.tldr: SCIQL combines explicit behavior-style supervision with offline value learning to improve task performance while preserving style alignment.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Universal Horizon Models
papers.tldr: Universal horizon models predict future states at flexible horizons, with capped training horizons improving offline reinforcement learning across 100 OGBench tasks.

papers.title: Online Robust Reinforcement Learning with General Function Approximation
papers.tldr: An online robust reinforcement learning algorithm learns through interaction and achieves sublinear regret governed by intrinsic functional complexity.

papers.title: Policy-Driven World Model Adaptation for Robust Offline Model-based Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: The framework jointly adapts a world model and policy through robust optimization, improving performance on noisy and stochastic offline-control benchmarks.

papers.title: Q-SAM: Unlocking Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalization in Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Q-SAM weights sharpness-aware updates using Q bounds to improve offline reinforcement-learning generalization while preserving training stability.

papers.title: RAD: Retrieval High-quality Demonstrations to Enhance Decision-making
papers.tldr: RAD guides offline reinforcement-learning plans toward retrieved, reachable high-return states using target-conditioned generated sub-trajectories.

papers.title: RAMAC: Multimodal Risk-Aware Offline Reinforcement Learning and the Role of Behavior Regularization
papers.tldr: RAMAC combines expressive generative policies, lower-tail risk optimization, and behavioral cloning to improve risk-sensitive offline reinforcement learning.

papers.title: REG: In-Sample RL via Regularizing the Evaluation Gap
papers.tldr: REG combines robust value evaluation with a projected policy update to achieve competitive offline reinforcement learning without diffusion-based computational costs.

papers.title: Regularized Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Hybrid Bayesian Belief
papers.tldr: PhyB approximates Bayesian uncertainty over environment dynamics to enable regularized offline policy optimization with bounded approximation error and improvement guarantees.

papers.title: SMAC: Score-Matched Actor-Critics for Robust Offline-to-Online Transfer
papers.tldr: SMAC aligns offline policy and value derivatives to enable smooth online fine-tuning, avoiding initial performance drops on all six evaluated D4RL tasks.

papers.title: SOLAR for Offline MARL: Plateau-Triggered Potential Shaping under World-Model Uncertainty
papers.tldr: SOLAR activates potential-based reward shaping after validated learning plateaus and reduces its strength where world-model uncertainty is high.

papers.title: Speedup Patch: Learning a Plug-and-Play Policy to Accelerate Embodied Manipulation
papers.tldr: Speedup Patch learns an offline scheduler that accelerates robot policies by removing redundant actions, achieving a reported 1.8-fold overall speedup.

papers.title: Target-Driven Policy Optimization for Sequential Counterfactual Outcome Control
papers.tldr: GIFT learns target-conditioned intervention policies from observational data using clipped importance weighting, with convergence guarantees under standard assumptions.

papers.title: Test-time Offline Reinforcement Learning on Goal-related Experience
papers.tldr: GC-TTT improves goal-conditioned policies during evaluation through brief updates on relevant offline experience.

papers.title: $\textDT^\text2$: Decision-Targeted Digital Twins
papers.tldr: DT² trains digital twins to preserve estimated policy rankings, improving policy selection while maintaining good simulation fidelity.

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Data Augmentation for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: Task-aware trajectory augmentation improves offline reinforcement learning from limited, suboptimal experience in positioning tasks.

papers.title: Unifying Value Alignment and Assignment in Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Heterogeneous Datasets
papers.tldr: V2A improves heterogeneous offline transfer by correcting value assignment before filtering source experience for target-domain learning.

papers.title: VIPO: Value Function Inconsistency Penalized Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.tldr: VIPO improves offline world models by penalizing disagreement between values learned from data and values estimated through the model.
